name: WHO HEAT
what_it_is: WHO Health Equity Assessment Toolkit: an R/Shiny web application visualizing within-country health inequalities through disaggregated data and 20+ summary inequality measures. Ships in two editions: built-in WHO database and HEAT Plus for user-uploaded datasets.
constraints: User uploads must not contain personal/privacy-violating data
Built-in data not under AGPL; restricted use
Ordered measures only for naturally ranked subgroups
HEAT Plus cloud needs Azure AD
notable_absences: HEAT Plus cloud config not published
